_comment: Single-GPU (RTX 3090, 24GB) low-memory pilot config for CloseBlenderLid skill-conditioned RL. The GRPO training loop itself is a successor card; this config drives the ENVIRONMENT: baseline + flow-SDE rollouts with log-prob capture.

hardware.notes: server(bf16 model)~10GB; run RL in-process client separately from socket server to avoid double-loading the model.

flow_sde._eta_note: 0 = deterministic (baseline). 0.6 = pilot exploration noise; sigma_k = eta*sqrt(1/num_steps).

grpo._note: group_size 4 fits the 3090 with the VLM frozen and only the DiT/adapters trained. This card produces the log-prob + branch-state data; the loop is the successor card.
